fields.description: Name shown in the map view selector.
fields.label: Name

fields.description: The DocType that holds the address (e.g. Customer, Supplier). Leave blank if this DocType itself holds the address.
fields.label: Via DocType

fields.description: Fieldname whose value is shown as the bold first line of the popup (e.g. customer_name). Leave blank to use the document name.
fields.label: Popup Line 1 Field

fields.description: Fieldname whose value is shown as the linked second line of the popup (e.g. customer_name). Leave blank to use the document name.
fields.label: Popup Line 2 Field

fields.description: Show Assign / Unassign button in the marker popup for this view.
fields.label: Allow Assign in Popup

fields.description: Comma-separated address types in priority order (e.g. Billing, Shipping). Listed types are preferred first; any remaining types follow in the default Frappe order. Leave blank to use only the default order.
fields.label: Address Type Priority

fields.description: If roles are set, only users with at least one listed role can use this view. If empty, only System Manager can use it.
fields.label: Allowed Roles

fields.description: Apply a marker color (and optionally shape) based on a field value. Rules are evaluated in order; the first match wins.
fields.label: Rules

fields.description: Add fields to include in the map marker popup below the address block.
fields.label: Popup Fields

fields.description: Default marker color for this view. Leave blank to use the global default.
fields.label: Default Color

fields.description: Default marker shape for this view. Leave blank to use the global default.
fields.label: Default Shape
